BrochureContent.Content:
Please note: Some images used in this listing are projected or digitally dressed images. These have been included to help illustrate the potential layout, scale, and possible use of the rooms. They are for visual guidance only and should not be taken as an exact representation of the current furnishings or finishes.


Special Features
•	Level ‘ B’ Ber certification/Green Mortgage
•	Solar Panels on roof
•	Requires Cosmetic work only 
•	CCTV to exterior
•	Detached residence in a highly convenient Dublin Road location, within easy reach of Kilkenny City Centre
•	Excellent access to Kilkenny Ring Road and the M9 motorway, convenient to Kilkenny Train Station and MacDonagh Junction Shopping Centre
•	Wide private driveway with excellent off-street parking, walled front garden
•	Generous and well-enclosed rear garden with development potential
•	Detached garage extending to approximately 152 sq. ft., excellent garage space for storage, workshop or hobby use, 
        this area has electricity and sewerage
•	A property offering excellent scope to personalise and enhance, all windows are tripled glazed with exception of rear sunroom and sliding door.
•	Versatile additional rear room measuring approximately 17'11" x 8'3"
•	Large 26'2" x 14'10" kitchen/living area
•	Three well-proportioned bedrooms
•	Convenient to primary and secondary schools, shops and sporting facilities

Middleknock represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a detached home with generous accommodation, private parking, a substantial rear garden and the considerable bonus of a detached garage — all within an established and exceptionally convenient Kilkenny City location.
Location is undoubtedly one of the strongest features of Middleknock. The Dublin Road is a long-established and highly convenient residential location, offering the considerable advantage of being within easy reach of Kilkenny City Centre while also providing excellent access to the Ring Road and onwards to the M9 Dublin/Waterford motorway.
Kilkenny Train Station, MacDonagh Junction Shopping Centre, schools, shops and the full range of city amenities are all readily accessible, making this a particularly practical location for families, commuters or anyone wishing to live close to the city.
The property itself offers well-proportioned accommodation over two floors, complemented by a generous rear garden, extensive off-street parking and the significant benefit of a detached garage/workshed.
On entering the property, an entrance porch leads through to a spacious hallway which provides access to the ground-floor accommodation. Conveniently positioned beneath the stairs is a guest WC.
The main living room is a substantial and comfortable space, measuring approximately 12'0" x 19'10", easily divideable. A gas fireplace provides a natural focal point to the room, while its size allows plenty of space for both everyday use and with difference options of use.
The real heart of the house is the impressive kitchen/living area, extending to approximately 26'2" x 14'10". This is an excellent-sized room with ample space to accommodate kitchen, dining and a family area within one large setting.
A door from the kitchen leads through to a further rear room measuring approximately 17'11" x 8'3". Currently finished with timber cladding leaves this room with huge potential, this is an versatile space. Depending on a purchaser's requirements, it could function as a utility area, additional reception room, home office, playroom or hobby space. Its position adjoining the rear of the house also creates a natural connection with the garden and holds a south facing aspect.
Moving to the first floor, the property provides three well-proportioned bedrooms.
The first bedroom measures approximately 13'11" x 9'6", while the second measures approximately 12'2" x 11'5" and benefits from built-in wardrobes together with its own shower unit. Bedroom three measures approximately 11'11" x 8'2" and also incorporates built-in wardrobes and a wash-hand basin.
A family bathroom completes the first-floor accommodation and is tiled, with a bath and overhead shower.
The outside space is another important feature of Middleknock. To the front, the residence is set back from Middleknock slip road, behind a walled garden, creating a defined boundary between the house and the streetscape.
A wide private driveway runs alongside the property, providing excellent off-street parking and convenient vehicular access directly to the rear offering easy access to develop the rear garden further.
The rear garden is surprisingly generous for such a convenient city location. Predominantly laid in lawn and well enclosed by its boundaries, it provides a private and usable outdoor area. A paved section immediately to the rear of the house offers an ideal space for outdoor seating and entertaining before opening onto the main lawn, the garden enjoys full sun.
Positioned towards the end of the garden is the detached garage, extending to approximately 152 sq. ft. This is a particularly useful addition, providing valuable storage, workshop or hobby space and further enhancing the overall practicality of the property.
The drone photography gives an excellent perspective on the scale of the site and demonstrates just how much outside space Middleknock enjoys while remaining so close to Kilkenny City.
For families, the location is particularly appealing, with a broad selection of primary and secondary schools accessible from this side of the city, together with shopping, sporting and recreational facilities. Kilkenny City Centre provides an extensive range of restaurants, cafés, shops and cultural attractions, with Kilkenny Castle and Castle Park among the many amenities within easy reach.  Ring Fran to view.
